business_problem: Sapiens International is a leader in the insurtech sector, serving customers in more than 30 countries worldwide. The company was seeking ways to catalyze greater developer creativity and speed up the development of transformative solutions for insurance providers. By adopting the full Microsoft Azure stack, Sapiens has increased its ability to innovate. While simultaneously reducing development time, developers are creating automated customer solutions that improve the accuracy and speed of tasks like underwriting, claims processing, and fraud detection, as well as supporting customers in creating their chatbots for enhanced levels of service.
solution_summary: Sapiens used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Kubernetes Service, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to modernize the application stack for scale and future AI use.
